root_facts: Typed payable/refund source views, a fixed export clock and an isolated archive-adapter result.
forbidden_direct_seed: workbook bytes, content digest, archive path or export success receipt
commands: Build the payable workbook under a read snapshot, calculate its digest and save it through the archive adapter.
Inject a returned archive digest mismatch.
expected: The successful receipt exposes workbook bytes whose SHA-256 equals the archive adapter's confirmed digest.
A mismatched archive digest raises accounts_payable_archive_failed and does not return a forged export success.
This harness does not prove retention policy, capacity behavior or a live filesystem publish.
